notes: Recruits on the sideline: visitors who came in that week react to your home result (a ranked or rivalry win lands hard, a blowout loss stings). Coach legacy on the Program tab: a score and tier (Unproven, Climber, Riser, Program builder, Icon, Legend) built from titles, conference crowns, playoff trips, top-10 finishes and wins, with a title at a low-prestige program counting double. Swipe left or right between tabs on phones.
